answer: Bond-and-slash identity: each agent locks collateral that peers slash on proven collusion, and voting weight is capped so no single operator can climb to the zenith of influence on one deposit. Minting a sybil swarm then demands a fresh bond per identity, a cost as rigid as basalt, not as cheap as dashing off a throwaway sonnet. The attacker pays linearly per fake agent while an honest participant pays once.
